title: Write the missing tests
prompt: vat.js has no tests. Write test file vat.test.js using node:test covering: the standard rate, the reduced rate, a zero amount, and a negative amount (which must throw). Then run the tests and make sure they pass.
check: node --test && node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('vat.test.js','utf8'); const n=(s.match(/\\btest\\(/g)||[]).length; if(n<4){console.error('only '+n+' tests');process.exit(1)}"
